conventions.commits: Conventional commits (feat(core): ...), GPG signed and DCO Signed-off-by, per recent history (e.g. dbc2971 Swift addition, #1742); AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md govern release tags.
conventions.testing: Inline #[cfg(test)] modules in each languages/*.rs (queries_compile, element query happy path, inheritance happy path and empty edge, defuse write site); table-driven tests in crates/aptu-coder-core/tests/integration_tests.rs; per-language semantic test in semantic_correctness.rs; MCP integration tests in crates/aptu-coder/tests/ via common::call_tool_raw and tempfile::NamedTempFile.
conventions.linting: cargo fmt --check; cargo clippy --locked --profile ci -- -D warnings (CI line 137); workspace lints deny undocumented_unsafe_blocks, unwrap_used, expect_used (test code exempt); cargo deny check advisories licenses bans (CI line 211); REUSE compliance; SPDX header on every new file.
conventions.error_handling: Handlers return Option/Vec and never panic: extract_function_name style uses end_byte bounds checks and get_node_text returns Option; query compile errors surface as ParserError::QueryError in parser.rs.

patterns: Each language module exports ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY as &str constants (java.rs, swift.rs, css.rs).
Element capture names drive extraction: 'function', 'func_name' or 'method_name', 'class', 'class_name' or 'type_name' (parser_elements.rs 276-300).
Inheritance handlers walk children of the class node and emit strings with 'extends ' or 'implements ' prefixes (java.rs, swift.rs).
Registry wiring: pub mod line, a LanguageInfo arm in get_language_info, a tree-sitter arm in get_ts_language, an EXTENSION_MAP row, and a supported_languages() entry.
DEFUSE captures use prefixes write., read., writeread.; parser_elements.rs de-duplicates reads at a write's byte offset.
The fallback in extract_imports_from_node stores the full import text as the module when no kind-specific arm matches.

constraints: Maintainers implement #1864 in-house; external PRs are not accepted (issue body 'Note on Process').
Scope limited to php.rs, languages/mod.rs, lang.rs, Cargo manifests and Cargo.lock, README and integration tests; no tool handler or schema changes.

approaches.name: A: Full Java-pattern handler (recommended)
approaches.description: New php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY (function_definition, method_declaration, class/interface/trait/enum declarations), CALL_QUERY (function, ->, ::), REFERENCE_QUERY (named_type), IMPORT_QUERY (namespace_use_declaration), DEFUSE_QUERY adapted to variable_name, and extract_inheritance walking base_clause and class_interface_clause. Grammar entry LANGUAGE_PHP (mixed HTML). Wire php in Cargo.toml, core Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, lang.rs EXTENSION_MAP and supported_languages, mod.rs pub mod plus two match arms; README update.
pros: Meets every acceptance criterion in the issue
Same shape as Java and Swift, so reviewers know the pattern
Only php.rs is new code; shared parser code is not touched
Inheritance and defuse tests are in-file and unit-testable
cons: Import module text falls back to the full 'use ...;' statement because parser_elements.rs has no namespace_use_declaration arm, so module names are less clean
DEFUSE pattern is inferred from grammar, not yet compiled against a parser (no cargo run in this scout pass)
Needs cargo deny age check: tree-sitter-php 0.25.2 GitHub release is 2026-11-19, about 8 days before run start, so it is borderline; 0.25.1 (2026-10-06) is the safe fallback

approaches.name: B: Minimal registry-only wiring
approaches.description: Add php to EXTENSION_MAP, supported_languages and mod.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY and CALL_QUERY only, and extract_inheritance and DEFUSE_QUERY set to None.
cons: Fails acceptance criteria: no inheritance, no defuse query, no import_query test coverage required by the issue
Java-style DEFUSE_QUERY is what makes write/read sites work; leaving it None means defuse-based features return nothing for PHP

approaches.name: C: Full handler plus shared namespace_use arm
approaches.description: Approach A, plus a new match arm in parser_elements.rs extract_imports_from_node for namespace_use_declaration that walks namespace_use_clause children to produce clean module and item pairs.
pros: Clean import module and item names for PHP
Makes the import output match Java-style structured imports
cons: Touches shared parser_elements.rs, outside the issue's Scope list (issue says no changes beyond the handler and registry)
Larger review surface and risk of regressions for other languages
Could be split into a follow-up issue

recommendation: Approach A. It is the only option that meets all acceptance criteria while keeping changes inside php.rs and the registry, and it follows the Java and Swift shape. Accept the imprecise import module names for now and raise a follow-up for a namespace_use arm (Approach C) rather than widening #1864. Pin tree-sitter-php at 0.25.2 only if it clears the 7-day age check on the crates.io publish date; otherwise pin 0.25.1.

inheritance_walk_citation: Grammar source: php/src/node-types.json (pinned tree-sitter-php 0.25.2 crate, same tree as master) and common/define-grammar.js on master. class_declaration has NO superclass field. Its rule is seq(optional(attribute_list), repeat(_modifier), keyword('class'), field('name', name), optional($.base_clause), optional($.class_interface_clause), field('body', declaration_list)). Walk: for each direct child of the class_declaration node (child(i), not child_by_field_name): (1) kind 'base_clause' (unfielded; rule seq(keyword('extends'), commaSep1($._name))) -> for each named child whose kind is 'name', 'qualified_name' or 'relative_name' (the _name supertype), emit format!("extends {text}"); (2) kind 'class_interface_clause' (unfielded; rule seq(keyword('implements'), commaSep1($._name))) -> for each named child of kind 'name'|'qualified_name'|'relative_name', emit format!("implements {text}"). Text is source[child.start_byte()..child.end_byte()]. Same walk applies to interface_declaration (base_clause only, multiple extends) and enum_declaration (class_interface_clause only, no base_clause). Class with no clauses: neither child kind present -> empty Vec. Note: PHP identifiers are 'name' nodes, not 'identifier', and must not be matched as identifier.
